mostWorthwhile.text: Following the tail cloud's stripped edge into the outer galaxy made its changing form and destination clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial tail combination felt less consequential on its own because it left the clumps' fate unresolved.

surprise.text: The outward stream stripped the tail cloud's edge rather than simply mixing with the whole cloud.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, although the final two combinations were the only offered actions rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the surviving clumps forming a new gathering makes me curious about what happens next.
